derivation: The checkpoint is built from a two-branch parallel block whose second head, outer-b, declares an absolute AT_OR_AFTER deadline on work-clock with expiry target parallel-join; the root effect enters the split carrying the latest work-clock record, so LIFE-014 installs that deadline PENDING on outer-b. outer-b is permitted and dispatched with an accepted acknowledgement, then a work-clock sample at the due instant expires it: the occurrence moves to completed as EXPIRED with the accepted clock evidence digest, the expiry relationship to parallel-join is selected, and under COMPOSITION 6.2 the branch-2 obligation becomes DISCHARGED with a DIRECT_EVENT basis whose evidence digest is the clock's; branch-1 stays OPEN, so no join fires. The dispatched request's matching effect then arrives for the closed occurrence: LIFE-010 classifies it LATE_MATCHED, LIFE-006 gives LATE_EFFECT, and OUTCOME_RETAINED changes nothing but the outcome list. A second conclusive record with the same provider-native operation identity and a different record digest is CONFLICTING under LIFE-013 with CONFLICTING_EFFECT; both outcomes become disputed and name each other, the dependency-affected set is outer-b alone, and the discharged branch-2 obligation becomes DISPUTED with its basis retained. A fresh available authority-clock sample asks the consumer to restart. LIFE-019 admits a completion-based DISPUTED obligation when its former discharge frontier intersects the dependency-affected set of a retained completed occurrence with disputed conclusive evidence, and a completed occurrence has such evidence when any retained governed outcome bound to its permit is disputed and asserts an established effect or no effect; that outcome need not be the record that completed the occurrence. Here no disputed outcome's digest equals the completed row's evidence digest, which is the clock's; the two disputed outcomes are bound to outer-b's permit, so the frontier, outer-b itself, intersects the set and the checkpoint is admitted. The authority-clock sample satisfies no deadline and is recorded with an empty reason set and no other change.
